title: DR-1 + SCALE-1: Disaster-Recovery Entity-Export Surface with Nightly Automation and 10x Synthetic Fleet Stress Test (SQUIRL OS)
description:
Two same-day operational-integrity batteries from the SQUIRL OS hub (prototype, synthetic data only).

DR-1 closes the final backup gap: a token-gated, service-role entity-export function with server-side PII stripping delivers a byte-exact baseline of 56 entities / 15,497 records to the public transparency repository, with nightly automation under a stamp-before-execute idempotency protocol. BackupStatus 4/4 verified. Disclosed: a server SDK list() quirk (numeric limit params return empty), and an explicit redaction doctrine (third-party vendor contacts redacted; owner personal-finance entity excluded from the public surface).

SCALE-1, preregistered with six falsifiers (all pass), seeds 2,320 synthetic records at 10x fleet scale: sub-second full read sweeps at 10-26x record counts, instant aggregation over 1,632 tasks, and a 2,320/2,320 tag-verified teardown returning byte-exact to baseline. Honest findings receipted: a string-typed field rejected 800 inserts (instrument defect, fixed), and a seed double-fire under a session error was absorbed completely by the tag-filter teardown - the same race the same-day idempotency amendment formalized. First use of the ScalingEvent entity. Write boundary measured at ~4-6 records/sec per connection.

Dual Mesh Benchmark: NOT MEASURED for these batteries. Per policy, the Dual Mesh Benchmark is marked MEASURED only for the DeepSeek column (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241) and NOT MEASURED otherwise.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All data is synthetic.
